instructions: Manage external plugin packages with {"action":"plugins","command":"install SOURCE"} where SOURCE is a package directory, ZIP, HTTPS URL, github:OWNER/REPO@REF, or catalog/ID@VERSION; other commands: new PATH, check PATH, search QUERY, info ID, update ID, enable ID, disable ID, uninstall ID, reload. New packages require plugin.json with instructions and a register(api) entrypoint. Edits and newly created trusted packages activate at idle message boundaries: finish the current turn with done before using a newly added tool. The operator can run the same commands after /plugins.
